## AvatarGroup.svelte

### `interface AvatarItem`

- `src` :: The portrait URL.
- `alt` :: Alternative text for the portrait. Defaults to `name`.
- `name` :: The person's name.
- `status` :: A presence indicator for this member.

### `interface Props`

- `items` :: The avatars to render. When set, `max` is applied and overflow is shown as "+N".
- `max` :: The number of avatars to show before collapsing the rest into a "+N" tile.
- `size` :: The size of every member, including the overflow tile.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment applied to every member and the overflow tile.
- `spread` :: Springs the stack apart on hover. Turn off for a still group.
- `children` :: Member avatars, used when `items` is omitted. Overflow is not applied to children.
